package.name: motor_ctrl
package.description: Cable-driven biped motor control: compile-time 12-motor map, USB-CAN adapter, Damiao MIT + Motorevo HA60 codec. P1: p1_dm_communicate / p1_evo_communicate (CAN ID is kCanId in the source). P2: p2_dm_test / p2_evo_test. P3 dual-bus: p3_dual_knee_spin (left CAN 6 ACM0 + right CAN 9 ACM1 Damiao MIT slow ramp). P4/P6 consume MBS state from the independent mbs_encoder package and /imu. Hip parallel FK/IK: hip_parallel_kin + p4_hip_kin_self_test (no hardware). P6 getState/sendCommand + quintic_traj: p6_traj_track (quintic about probe q0; default right 9-14; --self-test).
